en: Little Fish lives in the blue, blue sea. Swish, swish goes her tail.
Here is the coral, pink and orange. "Hello, coral!" says Little Fish.
Here is Turtle, swimming slowly. Paddle, paddle. "Hello, Turtle!"
Here is Starfish, holding on to a rock. "Hello, Starfish!"
Little Fish is sleepy now. She rests by the coral. Bubble, bubble, goodnight.
id: Ikan Kecil tinggal di laut yang biru, biru sekali. Kibas, kibas, ekornya bergoyang.
Ini karang, merah muda dan oranye. "Halo, karang!" sapa Ikan Kecil.
Ini Penyu, berenang pelan-pelan. Kayuh, kayuh. "Halo, Penyu!"
Ini Bintang Laut, menempel di batu. "Halo, Bintang Laut!"
Ikan Kecil mengantuk sekarang. Ia beristirahat di dekat karang. Blup, blup, selamat malam.

readAloudNotes.en: Wiggle your hand like a fish tail on "swish, swish".
readAloudNotes.id: Goyangkan tangan seperti ekor ikan saat "kibas, kibas".

readAloudNotes.en: Wave hello and invite your child to wave too. Point to the colours.
readAloudNotes.id: Lambaikan tangan dan ajak anak ikut melambai. Tunjuk warnanya.

readAloudNotes.en: Paddle slowly with flat hands, as slowly as you can.
readAloudNotes.id: Kayuh pelan dengan telapak tangan terbuka, sepelan mungkin.

readAloudNotes.en: Spread your fingers wide like a star and press them on your knee.
readAloudNotes.id: Rentangkan jari seperti bintang dan tempelkan di lutut.

readAloudNotes.en: Make soft bubble sounds with your lips and lower your voice for goodnight.
readAloudNotes.id: Buat bunyi gelembung pelan dengan bibir dan pelankan suara saat selamat malam.

objectives.en: Listens to a short story and joins in with repeated greetings and movements.
objectives.id: Mendengarkan cerita pendek dan ikut mengucapkan sapaan serta gerakan yang berulang.

objectives.en: Names three sea animals from the pictures: fish, turtle and starfish.
objectives.id: Menyebut tiga hewan laut dari gambar: ikan, penyu, dan bintang laut.

a sea animal with a hard shell and flippers

prompt.id: Apa yang dilakukan Ikan Kecil di akhir cerita?

connection.en: The sea is home to many different animals, such as fish, turtles and starfish.
connection.id: Laut adalah rumah bagi banyak hewan, seperti ikan, penyu, dan bintang laut.

connection.en: Coral is alive, so we look at it and never step on it.
connection.id: Karang itu hidup, jadi kita hanya melihatnya dan tidak menginjaknya.

discussionPrompts.en: Can you wave hello like Little Fish?
discussionPrompts.id: Bisakah kamu melambai seperti Ikan Kecil menyapa?

discussionPrompts.en: Which sea animal do you like best?
discussionPrompts.id: Hewan laut mana yang paling kamu suka?

offlineActivity.en: Spread a blue sarong or towel on the floor as the "sea". Your child "swims" across it with fish hands while you say hello to a pillow "turtle" and a cushion "starfish". There is no water in this game. Stay beside your child.
offlineActivity.id: Bentangkan sarung atau handuk biru di lantai sebagai "laut". Anak "berenang" melintasinya dengan tangan seperti ikan, sementara Anda menyapa bantal "penyu" dan bantal kecil "bintang laut". Permainan ini tanpa air. Tetaplah di samping anak.

factChecks.claim: Coral reefs are home to fish, sea turtles and starfish.
